mapper.select: WITH visible_diaries AS ( SELECT d.diary_id,d.public_id,d.title,d.diary_date,LEFT(d.content_text,160) AS content_snippet, d.mood_key AS mood,d.visibility,d.locked,d.version,d.created_at,d.updated_at, COUNT(*) OVER() AS diary_total FROM diary d WHERE d.space_id=#{spaceId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.visibility='SHARED' OR d.author_id=#{accountId}) ), recent_diaries AS ( SELECT * FROM visible_diaries ORDER BY diary_date DESC,diary_id DESC LIMIT 4 ), media_counts AS ( SELECT dm.diary_id,COUNT(*) AS media_count FROM recent_diaries r JOIN diary_media dm ON dm.diary_id=r.diary_id JOIN media_asset a ON a.asset_id=dm.asset_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status='READY' GROUP BY dm.diary_id ), image_profiles AS ( SELECT dm.diary_id,a.asset_id,a.public_id,a.media_type,dm.position,a.status, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='ORIGINAL' AND v.profile='source' THEN v.profile END), MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='ORIGINAL' THEN v.profile END)) AS original_profile, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='THUMBNAIL' AND v.profile='compact' THEN v.profile END), MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='THUMBNAIL' THEN v.profile END)) AS thumbnail_profile, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='PREVIEW' AND v.profile='screen' THEN v.profile END), MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='PREVIEW' THEN v.profile END)) AS preview_profile, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diary_media lock_dm JOIN diary lock_d ON lock_d.space_id=lock_dm.space_id AND lock_d.diary_id=lock_dm.diary_id WHERE lock_dm.space_id=a.space_id AND lock_dm.asset_id=a.asset_id AND lock_d.locked=1) AS protected_content FROM recent_diaries r JOIN diary_media dm ON dm.diary_id=r.diary_id JOIN media_asset a ON a.asset_id=dm.asset_id AND a.media_type='IMAGE' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status='READY' LEFT JOIN media_variant v ON v.asset_id=a.asset_id AND v.status='READY' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.variant_type IN ('ORIGINAL','THUMBNAIL','PREVIEW') GROUP BY dm.diary_id,a.asset_id,a.public_id,a.media_type,dm.position,a.status ), ranked_images AS ( SELECT image_profiles.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY diary_id ORDER BY position,asset_id) AS media_rank FROM image_profiles ) SELECT r.diary_id,r.public_id AS diary_public_id,r.title,r.diary_date,r.content_snippet,r.mood, r.visibility,r.locked,r.version,r.created_at,r.updated_at,r.diary_total, t.public_id AS tag_public_id,t.name AS tag_name,t.color AS tag_color, i.public_id AS media_public_id,i.media_type,i.position AS media_position, i.status AS media_status,COALESCE(i.protected_content,0) AS protected_content, i.original_profile,i.thumbnail_profile,i.preview_profile,COALESCE(c.media_count,0) AS media_count FROM recent_diaries r LEFT JOIN diary_tag dt ON dt.diary_id=r.diary_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.tag_id=dt.tag_id LEFT JOIN media_counts c ON c.diary_id=r.diary_id LEFT JOIN ranked_images i ON i.diary_id=r.diary_id AND i.media_rank<=4 ORDER BY r.diary_date DESC,r.diary_id DESC,t.name,t.tag_id,i.position,i.asset_id

SELECT d.public_id,d.draft_key,di.public_id AS diary_public_id, JSON_OBJECT('title',JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.payload,'$.title'))) AS payload_json, d.updated_at FROM diary_draft d LEFT JOIN diary di ON di.diary_id=d.diary_id WHERE d.space_id=#{spaceId} AND d.owner_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC,d.draft_id DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT public_id,title,anniversary_date FROM anniversary WHERE space_id=#{spaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order,anniversary_date,anniversary_id LIMIT 3

SELECT a.public_id,a.media_type,a.status, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diary_media lock_dm JOIN diary lock_d ON lock_d.space_id=lock_dm.space_id AND lock_d.diary_id=lock_dm.diary_id WHERE lock_dm.space_id=a.space_id AND lock_dm.asset_id=a.asset_id AND lock_d.locked=1) AS protected_content, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='ORIGINAL' AND v.profile='source' THEN v.profile END), MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='ORIGINAL' THEN v.profile END)) AS original_profile, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='THUMBNAIL' AND v.profile='compact' THEN v.profile END), MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='THUMBNAIL' THEN v.profile END)) AS thumbnail_profile, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='PREVIEW' AND v.profile='screen' THEN v.profile END), MAX(CASE WHEN v.variant_type='PREVIEW' THEN v.profile END)) AS preview_profile FROM favorite_media f JOIN media_asset a ON a.asset_id=f.asset_id AND a.space_id=f.space_id LEFT JOIN media_variant v ON v.asset_id=a.asset_id AND v.status='READY' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.variant_type IN ('ORIGINAL','THUMBNAIL','PREVIEW') WHERE f.space_id=#{spaceId} AND f.account_id=#{accountId} AND a.media_type='IMAGE' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status='READY' AND (#{elevated}=true OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM diary_media lock_dm JOIN diary lock_d ON lock_d.space_id=lock_dm.space_id AND lock_d.diary_id=lock_dm.diary_id WHERE lock_dm.space_id=a.space_id AND lock_dm.asset_id=a.asset_id AND lock_d.locked=1 )) GROUP BY f.created_at,f.asset_id,a.public_id,a.media_type,a.status ORDER BY f.created_at DESC,f.asset_id DESC LIMIT 6
